what: P8 negative control from docs/PREDICTION_INDUCTION_EMERGENCE.md, plus the instrument floor for every emergence metric, measured on a random-init size30m.
why: A metric that reports induction on random weights is wrong, and no trained-model number from it would be admissible. This is the floor every trained reading is measured against.
note: reduced sequence counts (registered are 256 and 512); the contrast against analytic chance does not need the registered count.

verdict.reading: max prefix-matching 0.005614 against analytic chance 0.005411745, a ratio of 1.037. Normalised entropy 0.9977 against 1.0 for uniform attention over the causal prefix. OV copying score centred on +0.0003 across all 64 heads. Every instrument sits at its analytic floor.
